name: Universal Verification Intelligence
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates nothing and owns no gate. Every obligation ./verify.sh enforced before it exists still exists, is still owned by the same instrument, and is still evaluated by the same command. What this programme owns is the QUESTION 'which verification does this change require, and in what order may it be executed' — never the question 'is this repository compliant', which remains with CMG-000001, UCOS-UGA-001, UAUE-000001, UOBC-000001, UISD-000001 and the coverage floor.
$why_this_exists: ./verify.sh executed one plan for every caller. Measured on the certification baseline: 11 628 tests, 97.61% coverage, every gate green, 2 814 s in pytest+coverage alone — and a developer changing one module paid all of it. The response that destroys assurance is to delete gates. The response that preserves it is to know which verification a change actually requires, to reuse evidence that provably still holds, and to execute independent read-only gates concurrently instead of sequentially. Nothing below removes a gate, lowers a threshold, or narrows a denominator; the whole of the change is in SELECTION, SCHEDULING and REUSE.
$not_a_second_authority: CAA-INV-04 recognises a second identity authority by the counter it advances; the declared mint marker is 'category_seq'. This programme holds no counter and no marker. It opens no registry that allocates, issues no identifier, declares no lifecycle stage (AUE-BND-06) and declares no rival object model (CAA-INV-07). The Test Object Registry and the Verification Evidence Registry are both DERIVED PROJECTIONS: the first is a view of 00-MASTER/UCOS-UGA-001/01-EXECUTABLE-OBJECT-REGISTRY.json filtered to the objects pytest collects, the second is a content-addressed cache of results whose keys are computed from object content hashes that UCOS-UGA-001 already owns. Neither is truth; deleting either changes no verdict, only the cost of reaching it.

principle.statement: Verification is a function of the change, not of the caller. The obligations are constant; the execution required to discharge them is derived.
principle.standing: DERIVED EXECUTION INTELLIGENCE, NOT AUTHORITY LAYER
principle.prohibited_condition: ASSURANCE REDUCTION BY SELECTION — a mode that reaches a verdict by measuring less than the obligation it claims to have measured.
principle.$prohibited_condition_rationale: A verification selector's dangerous failure is not slowness, it is a green run that skipped the affected test. So every mode declares exactly what it claims, no mode may claim more than it measured, and only the modes that measure the whole obligation are certification-eligible. UVI-L-05 computes that; it is not asserted.

mode_constitution.$standing: THE CONSTITUTION OF MODES. A mode is a declared claim plus the obligations that claim requires. Modes are DATA here and nowhere else: ./verify.sh parses this list to learn which flags it accepts, so a mode cannot exist in the script and not in the constitution, and UVI-L-01 measures that both directions hold.
mode_constitution.$default_rationale: The bare invocation is the one a developer types dozens of times a day, so it must be the mode whose cost matches that frequency — and it must still run every governance gate, because a commit is exactly where an ungoverned change enters. --change is that mode: impact-selected tests, every gate. Certification is not lost by this, it is made EXPLICIT: ./verify.sh --full is the certification contract and .github/workflows/ec1-ci.yml invokes it by name. A default that silently means 'certify' is how a 47-minute command became something developers route around.

modes.claim: The changed code lints, and every test reachable from the change passes.

The changed code lints, every test reachable from the change passes, and every governance, identity, lifecycle, evolution and certification gate in the contract holds over the repository as it now stands.
The whole suite passes under the 90% coverage floor and every gate in the contract holds.
Everything --integration claims, plus that registration state is valid.

mode_constitution.$budget_seconds: A DECLARED TARGET, never a gate. A verification that fails because it was slow is a verification that taught its callers to disable it. Exceeding a budget is reported by the plan and changes no verdict. 0 means no target is declared: certification is bounded by its obligations, not by a clock.

stage_registry.$standing: THE REGISTRY OF STAGES. ./verify.sh remains the DECLARED CONTRACT — the run_stage literals in it are what 00-MASTER/UAKOS-CLOSURE-008/validation-record.json digests and what .github/workflows/uisd-gate.yml re-derives. This registry does not restate that contract, it CLASSIFIES it: for each declared stage, which plane it executes on, what it depends on, which phase it may run in, and whether its result may be reused. UVI-L-03 measures that the label set here and the run_stage literals in verify.sh are equal and identically ordered, so a stage can never be classified here and absent there, or added there and unclassified here.

stages.label: prerequisite generation (knowledge · determinism · closure 1-3)
stages.$not_reusable: It is a producer. Reusing a producer means not producing, and the consumers of what it produces are in the same run.

stages.label: pytest + coverage gate (--cov-fail-under=90)
stages.$phase: ALONE, and this was learned by measurement rather than reasoned in advance. It was first classified MAIN and overlapped with the governance gates on the grounds that those gates are READ_ONLY. Read-only is not sufficient for concurrency: the gates measure the WHOLE version-controlled boundary, and the suite regenerates derived views under 00-BOOK/DATA and takes the git index lock while it does — one module's autouse fixture runs `git checkout` after every test in it. Run together, UCOS-UGA-001 read a torn tree and took 491s instead of 6s on lock contention. The gates cost about eight seconds between them, so serialising this stage against them costs nothing measurable and buys a gate that is measuring a settled tree.
stages.$not_reusable: The one stage whose result is the point of the run. It is selected, sharded and scheduled — never skipped, never reused.

stages.label: universal object governance (UGA-INV-01..10)
stages.$not_reusable: Its subject is the whole version-controlled boundary, so its input digest is the tree itself. A cache key that covers everything is never a hit and pretending otherwise would be the one reuse that could hide an unregistered object.

stages.label: autonomous universal evolution (UAUE gate, every declared obligation)
universal object birth contract (UOBC-000001, identity before existence)
universal infinite scope and direction (UISD-000001, unbounded and self-applied)
stages.$not_reusable: It scans declared roots across the whole repository for permanence declarations and closed enumerations, so like UGA its input is the tree.

stages.label: constitutional primitive alignment (UCPA-000001, root ontology measured and reduced)
stages.$not_reusable: The set of files it measures is DECLARED IN DATA, not fixed by this registry: ucpa-declaration.json names the canonical register, the ratification record, the owner binding and every classified projection, and that projection set is expected to grow as further sites are classified. A static reuse_inputs list would therefore go stale silently, which is the one thing a reuse decision must never do, so this stage is recomputed rather than reused.

stages.label: universal verification intelligence (UVI-000001, selection derived and assurance preserved)
coverage report
stages.$modes: Excluded from fast and change because those modes run --no-cov: there is no coverage data to summarise and a stale total is worse than none.

selection.$standing: Selection is DERIVED, never authored. No test path appears in this declaration or in engine/verification_intelligence/, and UVI-L-06 measures that: a literal test path in the selector would be a hand-maintained list wearing an engine's costume.

substrates.provides: universal_id, object_class, content_hash for every version-controlled object
the accountable owner of every object
resolved import edges, inverted for reverse reachability
owner → capability, so a change reaches the capability's whole test surface and not only its importers
owned_by / validated_by / evidenced_by / produces edges between identities that no import edge connects

layers.rule: Every changed path resolves to a registry record. A path with no record escalates: its dependents are unknown.
Transitive reverse closure over import edges. Every object that can reach the change is affected.
Every affected object contributes its owner, and every test object under an affected owner is selected — a test that exercises a module by subprocess or dynamic import has no import edge to it.
Every affected owner resolves to a capability. An owner absent from the capability catalogue escalates rather than resolving to nothing.
Every affected identity contributes its relationship-graph neighbours, and any test object among them is selected.

selection.escalation: FAIL WIDE. Every condition the layers cannot bound widens the plan to the whole suite under the coverage floor, and every widening names itself in the plan. The asymmetry is deliberate and is measured by UVI-L-07.

execution.$standing: Scheduling changes when a stage runs, never what it measures. UVI-L-08 computes that: the union of the shards must equal the whole selection exactly, and the coverage denominator must be identical to the one a single process would have produced.

topology.PREFLIGHT: concurrent — ruff reads tracked Python, prerequisite generation writes gitignored paths, and they share nothing
topology.TESTS: alone — the suite regenerates derived views and takes the git index lock, so nothing may read the tree beside it
topology.MAIN: concurrent — every stage in it is READ_ONLY and measures a tree nothing is writing to any more

test_sharding.assignment: DETERMINISTIC LONGEST-PROCESSING-TIME. Test files are ordered by measured cost descending, ties broken by path, and each is placed in the least-loaded shard. Given one cost table and one selection the assignment is a pure function, so two planners on two machines produce identical shards.
test_sharding.$max_workers: A CEILING, not a count. The planner takes the smaller of this and the machine's own CPU count, so a two-core CI runner plans two shards and a fourteen-core workstation plans twelve. UVI_WORKERS overrides both, for measurement.

isolated.$measured: It asserts a property of the WHOLE working tree — it snapshots `git status --porcelain`, runs the observing stages, and asserts the tree did not move — and its autouse fixture runs `git checkout -- 00-BOOK/DATA/ 00-BOOK/REGISTRIES/ 00-BOOK/CONTROL-TOWER/` after every test in the module. Both directions were measured to interfere: a concurrent shard regenerating a derived view moves the tree under its assertion, and its own checkout reverts what that shard just wrote. Neither is a defect in the test, which is correct about a serial repository.
isolated.$effect: It runs ALONE and FIRST, before the concurrent body. Alone because the other shards perturb it. First because it must observe the tree as verification FOUND it — the fixed point the preflight phase just established — rather than the tree eleven thousand tests happened to leave behind. Running it last was tried and measured: the suite regenerates derived views, so the object reached a different verdict depending on what had run before it, for reasons unrelated to what it measures. Nothing is deselected and nothing is skipped: the scope is identical, only the schedule differs.

isolated.$measured: Its gate proves DETERMINISM — `identical repository state implies byte-identical outputs` — and one of the inputs that state includes is `coverage.xml`, from which intelligence/research/assimilation.py derives research findings. `coverage.xml` is gitignored and run-scoped, and every pytest shard rewrites it: measured during one ./verify.sh --fast, it changed 17 times in 80 seconds and was repeatedly TRUNCATED TO EMPTY (sha256 e3b0c44298..., the empty-file digest). The engine caches its corpus on the instance while verify_determinism() re-reads fresh, and the fixture holds that cache module-wide, so a concurrent truncation lands between the two reads. Measured on the failing run itself: `deterministic=false` with `checks=13/13 PASS`, findings 18 -> 14 and records 203 -> 198 — exactly the coverage-derived findings, lost mid-read.
isolated.$effect: It runs ALONE, so no other shard is writing `coverage.xml` while it compares. This is SCHEDULING and not selection: the determinism assertion is unchanged, still fail-closed, and the object still runs in every mode that admits it. The gate was never wrong — its premise, an unchanging repository state, was being violated by the verification run itself, and isolation makes that premise true rather than weakening the claim.

test_sharding.$isolated: Path prefixes MEASURED to be unsafe to run beside anything else — typically because they assert a property of the whole working tree, or mutate one. Each entry must carry the measurement that justifies it. This is scheduling isolation and never selection: an isolated object still runs, in exactly one shard, and UVI-L-08 measures the union exactly as it does for every other unit. It is deliberately expensive — an isolated object serialises its own cost onto the wall clock — so the bar for adding one is a measurement, not a suspicion.
test_sharding.cost_source: 00-MASTER/UVI-000001/test-cost-model.json — measured durations, absent entries priced at the declared default
test_sharding.isolation: Every shard is a separate process with its own COVERAGE_FILE. Coverage data is combined before the floor is evaluated, so the floor is evaluated exactly once, over the union, by the coverage tool itself.
test_sharding.$why_not_a_plugin: pytest-xdist would add an unpinned distributed-execution dependency and move shard assignment inside a scheduler this repository does not own. Sharding by process keeps the assignment declared, deterministic and auditable, and adds no dependency to a toolchain that is pinned on purpose (DE-04).

evidence_registry.$standing: A CACHE, NOT A RECORD OF TRUTH. Every entry is keyed by a digest computed from the content hashes UCOS-UGA-001 already publishes for the stage's declared inputs, plus the stage's own command. A hit means the identical stage has already been executed over identical input and passed. Deleting the whole store changes no verdict — it only makes the next run pay again.
evidence_registry.$tracked: Untracked by design and by .gitignore. A cache in the tree would be a second answer to 'did this pass', and the first thing to drift.
reuse_conditions: the recorded input digest equals the digest computed now
the recorded verification-intelligence version equals the running one
evidence_registry.$certification_never_reuses: integration and full declare evidence_reuse false. A certification that reuses a result certifies a cache. UVI-L-09 computes that no certification-eligible mode can reach a reuse decision at all.

no_assurance_reduction.$standing: THE RATCHET. These are the stage labels ./verify.sh declared BEFORE this programme existed, copied from 00-MASTER/UAKOS-CLOSURE-008/validation-record.json as it stood at the baseline run — 11 628 tests, 97.61% coverage, every gate green. UVI-L-04 measures that every one of them is still a declared stage AND is still admitted by every certification-eligible mode. Removing a gate, or quietly dropping one out of --full, fails here rather than being discovered later by its absence.

universal object birth contract (UOBC-000001, identity before existence)
universal infinite scope and direction (UISD-000001, unbounded and self-applied)

laws.title: Mode Constitution Completeness
laws.statement: Every mode ./verify.sh accepts is declared here, and every mode declared here is accepted by ./verify.sh. Neither set may exceed the other.

laws.title: Exactly One Default
laws.statement: Exactly one mode is declared default, and the bare invocation of ./verify.sh resolves to it.

laws.title: Stage Registry Reconciliation
laws.statement: The stage labels declared here, in declared order, equal the run_stage literals ./verify.sh declares, in source order. A stage cannot be classified without being declared, or declared without being classified.

laws.title: No Assurance Reduction
laws.statement: Every stage of the pre-existing certification contract is present in every certification-eligible mode. No gate was removed, and no threshold was lowered.

laws.title: A Mode May Not Claim More Than It Measures
laws.statement: Only a mode whose selection is the whole suite and whose coverage is the declared floor may be certification-eligible. Any mode that is not certification-eligible declares what it does not claim.

laws.title: Selection Is Derived, Never Authored
laws.statement: No test path literal appears in the selector or in this declaration. Selection derives from identity, ownership, dependency, capability and relationship, and every declared substrate is actually read.

laws.title: Fail Wide
laws.statement: Every condition the selector cannot bound escalates to the whole suite under the coverage floor, and names the reason. An unbounded change never produces a narrow plan.

laws.title: Execution Topology Neutrality
laws.statement: Scheduling and sharding change no measured obligation: the union of the shards equals the selection exactly, no test is placed twice, and the coverage floor is evaluated once over combined data.

laws.title: Evidence Reuse Integrity
laws.statement: A result may be reused only when the recomputed input digest equals the recorded one, and never by a certification-eligible mode.

laws.title: Deterministic Planning
laws.statement: Planning twice over one repository state produces byte-identical plans, and no wall clock enters a plan.

laws.title: Every Declared Read-Set Resolves
laws.statement: Every prefix a stage declares as a reuse input resolves to at least one registered object. A read-set that matches nothing is a declaration naming a path the repository does not carry, and it silently disables reuse for that stage forever rather than failing.

$law_checks: Every law names a check that computes it. The contract refuses to construct itself if a law names a check that does not exist, or if a check exists that no law claims — the discipline UISD-000001 and UOBC-000001 already apply.

self_application.$meaning: The selector is itself a selected object. engine/verification_intelligence/ carries universal identity, is owned, is registered, is tested, and its own change escalates like any other: it is named in the unbounded set, because a change to the thing that decides what to verify cannot be verified by asking it what to verify.

exit_codes.1: INCOHERENT — a law was measured and refused
exit_codes.2: FAULT — no verdict could be reached
